evidence: Loads a 32-bit selector at input+0xd38, uses it to select a 32-bit value from input+0x101400+selector*4, reads a byte at input+0x1d56, places these values in vector arguments, then tailcalls stadium_lighting_request_and_buffer_switch (0x70012d1e04). Its caller invokes this after another lighting helper succeeds. The name describes the observed request preparation/forwarding without assigning meanings to the fields. decompiled/main/main_0138.c:11328-11347; caller decompiled/main/main_0180.c:1336-1340.

The entire body is a musttail forwarding wrapper to the accepted format_player_attribute_rating_details helper (0x7000cd9eb0). Its caller invokes it after a preceding condition passes. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:23917-23922; caller decompiled/main/main_0088.c:29204-29208.

Reads three 32-bit values from the supplied record at +8, +0xc, and +0x10. It calls a predicate helper with the record pointer and uses the result to form a Boolean in x1, then tailcalls the accepted dispatch_nested_interface_call helper (0x7000d81570), passing the +0xc value in x0, +8 in x2, and +0x10 in x3. No indexed direct caller was available, so the name is limited to the visible forwarding behavior. decompiled/main/main_0092.c:8399-8419.

Returns immediately unless the accepted attribute_context_status_value_is_8 predicate (0x70000a8190) succeeds. On success it loads a global object pointer from 0x70045c2528 and calls f_7001676008 on that object and on offsets +0x390 and +0x720. The helper body clears/initializes multiple fields of each supplied object block. No indexed direct caller was available; the label states only the gate and repeated reset operation. decompiled/main/main_0158.c:44932-44955; reset helper decompiled/main/main_0158.c:46245-46270.

Reads two 32-bit index values from input+152, passes the record and those values to the accepted add_preset_attribute_record_value helper (0x7000bc80b0), reads a 32-bit value at input+0x98 and passes it with the record to another helper, then calls a follow-up helper on the record. No indexed direct caller was available, so the name stays close to the confirmed preset-value update and visible follow-up calls. decompiled/main/main_0082.c:18692-18710.
